items.title: Iceland Noir 2026
items.why: We recommend this for anyone that is into good stories. This 4 day festival doesn't just cover books, but rather celebrates creativity across genres and storytelling mediums.

items.title: Improv Ísland
items.why: These shows are weekly and always very entertaining. A super talented group with a guest star. Definitely recommend checking it out!

items.title: Psycho
items.why: Watch one of the more famous horror/thriller movies with the most iconic soundtrack (shower scene) with live music! This one will definitely get your heart racing.

items.title: Hjartasvellið 2026
items.why: The best way to kick off the christmas season is going to Hafnarfjörður, getting a hot cup of cocoa and going ice skating. This will be the start of the christmas village.

items.title: Púðursykur
items.why: Killer lineup of Iceland's best comedians that will guarantee a good time.

items.title: Todmobile
items.why: One of Iceland's most iconic bands is playing at Harpa, a night you don't want to miss!

items.title: Feita hjartað
items.why: You don't want to miss Iceland's comedian Dóri DNA in his insightful new special

items.title: REYKJAVIK
items.why: Celebrating 55 years of friendship between Iceland and China with an action packed lineup!
